{{Top|leg}}
An '''enviro filter''' or '''air filter''' was a device designed to allow wearers to breathe normally in environments that would be otherwise dangerous. Some filters were sealed, with an integrated [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] supply, to allow the wearer to breathe in the absence of an environment. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]] had a sealed enviro filter as part of her suit of armor, with a three hour supply of oxygen; the helmets of many [[Armor/Legends|armor]] sets had air filters. They were a standard part of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and even some heavily-urbanized worlds such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Servicing of the air filters was part of a standard maintenance package.
